subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: The tracker shall resolve a work item's direct children (FR-19) and its open-children rollup (FR-7) in time bounded by the number of children, not by the size of the whole store — with no full-corpus scan on the children or rollup query path — while the child's `parent` field remains the sole authoritative record of the edge.
fit_criterion: children/rollup latency for a parent with a fixed k children stays within NFR-1 and does not grow with total item count N, measured at N = 10³, 10⁴, and 10⁵; any index that backs the path is rebuildable from the item files and is bypassed by decision-path reads (NFR-3)
